hook: Stunning upsets shook the opening round of the 2026-27 German Bundesliga!

sections.voiceover: Stunning upsets shook the opening round of the 2026-27 German Bundesliga!
Grandmaster Aydin Suleymanli played with 2679 Elo against Grandmaster Nikita Meshkovs at 2521 Elo. Opening round matches started with the Queen's Indian Defense. How many moves decided the board?
Nikita Meshkovs fought hard, but 41 moves ended the game.
